content:
 Tip
This query uses kind=inner  to specify an inner-join, which prevents deduplication of left
side values for DeviceId .
Kusto
Use the following query to get information on file related events.
Kusto
Use the following query to get information on network related events.
Kusto
DeviceInfo
//Query for devices that the potentially compromised account has logged onto
| where LoggedOnUsers contains '<account-name>'
| distinct DeviceId
//Crosscheck devices against alert records in AlertEvidence and AlertInfo tables
| join kind=inner AlertEvidence on DeviceId
| project AlertId
//List all alerts on devices that user has logged on to
| join AlertInfo on AlertId
| project AlertId, Timestamp, Title, Severity, Category
